description: Source code for the Twig Token class, defining token types, methods for token testing, and string representations.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Final class representing tokens in Twig, with constants for token types, methods for token testing, and string conversion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Token with type, value, and line number.

methods.description: Returns a string representation of the token.

methods.description: Tests if the token matches a given type and/or value.

methods.description: Returns the type of the token.
